title: Avoid Citus when distribution key and portability are unresolved

why_now: The intake explicitly raises Citus but also identifies portability and distribution-key concerns.
why_not_yet: Distributed PostgreSQL should wait until hot paths prove a stable distribution key and the team can operate cluster-aware backup, restore, and rebalancing.
triggers_for_next_stage: Revisit only after single-primary tuning, partitioning, and tenant-local query traces have been exhausted.
